items.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001
items.q: Don is a musician, Don Walker, and a composer. I keep being embarrassed that this guy has more brains than I, is doing all this slave work and seems to enjoy it.

ctx.x: Well it sounds like a fun job too, a little bit like being a detective.
Don is a musician, Don Walker, and a composer. I keep being embarrassed that this guy has more brains than I, is doing all this slave work and seems to enjoy it. I don’t see how he can.
Take it as a big compliment.
